title: Troubleshooting: payment didn't go through
summary: This document troubleshoots failed payments by outlining immediate checks (available funds, current recipient details, scheduled amount within limits, and scheduled date compatible with the funding method). It explains auto-retry behavior (up to 3 attempts if Yes is enabled) and what to do after the final attempt, plus common causes and how to contact in-app support with the schedule name and processing date.
faqs: What should I verify right away when a scheduled payment didn’t go through?
If auto-retry is enabled, how many times will the system retry the payment?
What should I do if all 3 auto-retry attempts fail?
How do I fix common causes like insufficient funds, recipient issues, amount limits, or timing conflicts?
If I can’t find the cause, what information should I collect and send to in-app support?
keywords: occurrence will not process after final attempt
in-app support with schedule name and processing date
